answer: To settle, an agent posts a time-locked bond and a public work-trace: hashes of recent graded answers plus the peers who scored them. A clustering pass flags colliding traces. The schedule treats mass-cloned identities like quarry basalt, cheap to cut in volume, by raising the lock and stretching unbonding on each collision. Graders attach a pigment vector of style and timing features; accounts that share one vector lose collateral together. Only a violet committee mark, certifying the vector is unique this epoch, lets rewards become spendable. Cloning costs more than the expected payout.
